episodes.title: Mallikajaan - The Queen of Heeramandi
episodes.summary: As Mallikajaan reigns over her courtesans, rebellion grows on the streets. Alamzeb has her first brush with love. Wali shares key information with Bibbo.

episodes.title: Fareedanjaan - The Challenger Returns
episodes.summary: Heartbroken by a nawab, Lajjo turns to drink and dance to win back her former lover. Mallikajaan reveals a dark secret as her past catches up with her.

episodes.title: Waheedajaan - Scarred for Life
episodes.summary: The return of Fareedan to Khwabgah raises tensions as Mallikajaan schemes to cling onto her control. Waheedan makes a bold move of her own.

episodes.title: Alamzeb - The Innocent Pawn
episodes.summary: As her dance debut approaches, Alam questions her place at Heeramandi. Saima unwittingly earns Mallikajaan's ire and Fareedan strikes back.

episodes.title: Tajdar - The Lover’s Dilemma
episodes.summary: As Mallikajaan and the courtesans fervently search for Alam, Tajdar comes to her rescue. Meanwhile, an enraged Waheedan has a proposal for Fareedan.

episodes.title: Tajdar & Alamzeb - Nation v/s Love
episodes.summary: Alam and Tajdar's romance intensifies as a rebellion is being hatched. Mallikajaan and Fareedan uncover dark and disturbing secrets about each other.

episodes.title: Bibbojaan - Long Live the Revolution
episodes.summary: Cartwright's scheme against the courtesans unfolds. Seeking a future with Alam, Tajdar approaches Mallikajaan — but her approval comes at a price.

episodes.title: Heeramandi - The Swan Song
episodes.summary: The fight for freedom reaches the steps of Heeramandi — for both the courtesans and the country. Will the battle end in victory or result in ruination?
